subject: math
description: Rebuild core geometry recall around triangles, quadrilaterals, perimeter, area, and angle relationships through diagram reading, visual marking, and interactive figure analysis.
learningObjectives: Recall high-yield area, perimeter, and angle formulas quickly
Identify the important givens in a geometry figure before choosing a formula
Translate a geometry diagram into known relationships step by step
Use triangle and quadrilateral properties to reduce guesswork
Catch unreasonable geometric answers using approximation and unit checks
